// JSX reader for the phase 2C guards (tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts). It is not a parser: it skips {…},
// quoted values and comments inside braces, so `=>` in an onChange and `[&>svg]` in a class never end a tag.
// When a guard misreads a file, fix the reader and add the case to the reader test in that file; never raise a budget.
export type JsxTag = { name: string; start: number; end: number; line: number; text: string; selfClosing: boolean }
export type JsxElement = JsxTag & { children: string | null; closeEnd: number }

// Index just past the ">" that closes an opening tag, scanning from `from` (just after the tag name). -1 if the source ends first.
export function endOfOpeningTag(source: string, from: number): number {
  let depth = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  for (let index = from; index < source.length; index++) {
    const char = source[index]
    if (quote) {
      if (char === "\\") index++
      else if (char === quote) quote = null
      continue
    }
    if (depth > 0 && char === "/" && source[index + 1] === "/") {
      const lineEnd = source.indexOf("\n", index)
      if (lineEnd === -1) return -1
      index = lineEnd
      continue
    }
    if (depth > 0 && char === "/" && source[index + 1] === "*") {
      const commentEnd = source.indexOf("*/", index + 2)
      if (commentEnd === -1) return -1
      index = commentEnd + 1
      continue
    }
    if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === "`") quote = char
    else if (char === "{") depth++
    else if (char === "}") depth--
    else if (char === ">" && depth === 0) return index + 1
  }
  return -1
}

// Every opening tag whose name matches one of `names` (each a regex source, such as "input" or "[A-Z][\\w.]*").
// A match on a line that starts with //, /* or * is a comment and is skipped.
export function findJsxTags(source: string, names: readonly string[]): JsxTag[] {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`<(${names.join("|")})(?=[\\s/>])`, "g")
  const tags: JsxTag[] = []
  let line = 1
  let counted = 0
  for (const match of source.matchAll(pattern)) {
    const start = match.index
    for (; counted < start; counted++) if (source.charCodeAt(counted) === 10) line++
    const lineStart = source.lastIndexOf("\n", start) + 1
    const before = source.slice(lineStart, start).trimStart()
    if (before.startsWith("//") || before.startsWith("/*") || before.startsWith("*")) continue
    const end = endOfOpeningTag(source, start + match[0].length)
    if (end === -1) continue
    const text = source.slice(start, end)
    tags.push({ name: match[1], start, end, line, text, selfClosing: text.endsWith("/>") })
  }
  return tags
}

// Each element of one name with the text between its opening and closing tag. Same-name nesting is counted.
// children is "" for a self-closing tag and null when no closing tag is found.
export function findJsxElements(source: string, name: string): JsxElement[] {
  return findJsxTags(source, [name]).map((tag) => {
    if (tag.selfClosing) return { ...tag, children: "", closeEnd: tag.end }
    const pattern = new RegExp(`<(/?)${name}(?=[\\s/>])`, "g")
    pattern.lastIndex = tag.end
    let depth = 1
    for (let match = pattern.exec(source); match; match = pattern.exec(source)) {
      if (match[1] === "/") {
        depth--
        if (depth === 0) return { ...tag, children: source.slice(tag.end, match.index), closeEnd: source.indexOf(">", match.index) + 1 }
        continue
      }
      const end = endOfOpeningTag(source, match.index + match[0].length)
      if (end === -1) break
      if (!source.slice(match.index, end).endsWith("/>")) depth++
      pattern.lastIndex = end
    }
    return { ...tag, children: null, closeEnd: tag.end }
  })
}

// The tag text with every {…} emptied to {} and every quoted value emptied to "", so attribute checks
// never look inside expressions or class strings.
function attributeSkeleton(tagText: string): string {
  let out = ""
  let depth = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  for (let index = 0; index < tagText.length; index++) {
    const char = tagText[index]
    if (quote) {
      if (char === "\\") index++
      else if (char === quote) {
        quote = null
        if (depth === 0) out += char
      }
      continue
    }
    if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === "`") {
      quote = char
      if (depth === 0) out += char
    } else if (char === "{") {
      if (depth === 0) out += char
      depth++
    } else if (char === "}") {
      depth--
      if (depth === 0) out += char
    } else if (depth === 0) out += char
  }
  return out
}

export function hasJsxAttr(tagText: string, attr: string): boolean {
  return new RegExp(`\\s${attr}(?=[\\s=/>])`).test(attributeSkeleton(tagText))
}

// The raw value of an attribute: what is inside {…} or the quotes, "" for a bare flag, null when the attribute is missing.
export function jsxAttrValue(tagText: string, attr: string): string | null {
  let depth = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  for (let index = 0; index < tagText.length; index++) {
    const char = tagText[index]
    if (quote) {
      if (char === "\\") index++
      else if (char === quote) quote = null
      continue
    }
    if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === "`") quote = char
    else if (char === "{") depth++
    else if (char === "}") depth--
    if (quote || depth !== 0 || !/\s/.test(char)) continue
    const nameEnd = index + 1 + attr.length
    if (!tagText.startsWith(attr, index + 1) || !/[\s=/>]/.test(tagText[nameEnd] ?? "")) continue
    if (tagText[nameEnd] !== "=") return ""
    const open = tagText[nameEnd + 1]
    if (open === '"' || open === "'") return tagText.slice(nameEnd + 2, tagText.indexOf(open, nameEnd + 2))
    if (open !== "{") return ""
    const close = closingBrace(tagText, nameEnd + 1)
    return close === -1 ? null : tagText.slice(nameEnd + 2, close)
  }
  return null
}

// Index of the "}" that closes the "{" at `open`, skipping quoted text. -1 if there is none.
function closingBrace(text: string, open: number): number {
  let depth = 0
  let quote: string | null = null
  for (let index = open; index < text.length; index++) {
    const char = text[index]
    if (quote) {
      if (char === "\\") index++
      else if (char === quote) quote = null
    } else if (char === '"' || char === "'" || char === "`") quote = char
    else if (char === "{") depth++
    else if (char === "}" && --depth === 0) return index
  }
  return -1
}

// Counts per file from a counting function, for ratchet guards. Files counted as 0 are left out.
export function countByFile(files: SourceFile[], count: (file: SourceFile) => number, allow: (path: string) => boolean = () => false): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const file of files) {
    if (allow(file.path)) continue
    const value = count(file)
    if (value > 0) counts[file.path] = value
  }
  return counts
}

// "path: count > budget" for every file over its budget. A file missing from the budget has a budget of 0.
export function budgetOverruns(counts: Record<string, number>, budget: Record<string, number>): string[] {
  return Object.entries(counts)
    .filter(([path, count]) => count > (budget[path] ?? 0))
    .map(([path, count]) => `${path}: ${count} > ${budget[path] ?? 0}`)
}
```

import type React from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type StickyFormFooterProps = React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  /** Status line, such as "3 unsaved changes". Above the buttons on phones, on the left from sm. A live region is the caller's job. */
  status?: React.ReactNode
}

/**
 * Save bar for long forms (spec 2C K14, I22). Render it as the last child of the <form>, so type="submit", Enter in a
 * field and the busy guard keep working. It sticks to the bottom of the dashboard scroll area (main, which has
 * py-4 sm:py-6 and px-4 sm:px-6) and rests at the end of the form once the user scrolls there; it never measures
 * the sidebar. Flat like the other full-bleed sticky bars: a top line and the canvas fill.
 * Children are the buttons in DOM order, secondary (cancel) first and primary last (K8): a full-width column on
 * phones, a right-aligned row from sm. Only for focus-task routes: the mobile bottom navigation would cover it
 * (tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts GL1).
 */
export function StickyFormFooter({ status, className, children, ...props }: StickyFormFooterProps) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="sticky-form-footer"
      className={cn(
        "sticky -bottom-4 z-10 -mx-4 border-t border-border bg-canvas px-4 pt-3 pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] sm:-bottom-6 sm:-mx-6 sm:px-6",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        {status ? <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-meta text-muted-foreground">{status}</div> : null}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:ml-auto sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-end">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

- [ ] **Step 2: Save the budget script**

Every migration commit lowers its own file's budgets, adds the file to `MIGRATED_FILES`, and, once all its dialogs use the footer part, takes it out of `PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS` (spec §9.9). Two budget objects can hold the same line text for one file (`RAW_FIELDS` and `FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS` both hold `5` for the plan form), so exact-string edits cannot target them. This script edits by object name instead. It checks each current value against the number you pass and writes nothing on a mismatch. Save it as `p2c-budget.mjs` in your temp folder (never in the repo):

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

`NAME=from:to` lowers the entry from `from` to `to`, and `to = 0` deletes the line. `NAME=1:1` keeps an entry that this task must leave in place. Any budget that still holds a number for the file must be named, so no row is forgotten. Use `:` and not `>`, because the shell reads `>` as a redirect.

```tsx
  function setField<K extends keyof typeof values>(field: K, value: (typeof values)[K]) {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }))
  }

  // New picks append to the list; each file can be taken out before saving.
  function addFiles(next: File[]) {
    setFiles((current) => [...current, ...next])
  }

  function removeFile(id: string) {
    setFiles((current) => current.filter((_, index) => String(index) !== id))
  }

function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        {label}
        {required ? <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span> : null}
      </span>
      {children}
    </label>
  )
}

function Choice({ name, checked, label, onSelect }: { name: string; checked: boolean; label: string; onSelect: () => void }) {
  return (
    <label
      className={`flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors ${
        checked ? "border-primary bg-primary-soft font-medium text-foreground" : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
      }`}
    >
      <input type="radio" name={name} checked={checked} onChange={onSelect} className="h-4 w-4 accent-primary" />
      {label}
    </label>
  )
}

```

with:

```tsx
  function close() {
    if (saving) return
    setDialog(null)
    setFiles([])
  }

  // New picks append to the list; each file can be taken out before saving.
  function addFiles(next: File[]) {
    setFiles((current) => [...current, ...next])
  }

  function removeFile(id: string) {
    setFiles((current) => current.filter((_, index) => String(index) !== id))
  }
```

function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        {label}
        {required ? <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span> : null}
      </span>
      {children}
    </label>
  )
}

function DialogButtons({ saving, onBack, backLabel, submitLabel }: { saving: boolean; onBack: () => void; backLabel: string; submitLabel: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col justify-end gap-2 sm:flex-row">
      <button type="button" onClick={onBack} disabled={saving} className={secondaryButton}>{backLabel}</button>
      <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-primary px-4 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover disabled:opacity-50">
        {saving ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />}{submitLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

This is the same script as Task 9 Step 2. If `<temp>/p2c-budget.mjs` is not there, save this as `p2c-budget.mjs` in your temp folder (never in the repo):

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

with:

```ts
// Phase 2C (spec 6.5.1, guard GB4): `disabled` may still hold another condition (a validation gate, the form's own
// save), but never the busy expression itself: that would drop keyboard focus the moment the work starts.
function repeatsBusy(tag: string): boolean {
  if (!/\sdisabled[=\s/>]/.test(tag)) return false
  if (/\sdisabled(?=[\s/>])/.test(tag)) return true
  const busy = /\sbusy=\{([^}]*)\}/.exec(tag)?.[1]?.trim()
  if (!busy) return true
  const disabled = /\sdisabled=\{([^}]*)\}/.exec(tag)?.[1] ?? ""
  const escaped = busy.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")
  return new RegExp(`(?<![\\w.$])${escaped}(?![\\w$])`).test(disabled)
}

test("busy comes from client state, and a busy Button's disabled never repeats the busy condition", () => {
  assert.equal(repeatsBusy("<Button busy={saving} disabled={saving || missingPhoto}>"), true)
  assert.equal(repeatsBusy("<Button busy={saving} disabled>"), true)
  assert.equal(repeatsBusy("<Button busy={legacyBackfillSavingId === asset.id} disabled={saving}>"), false)
  assert.equal(repeatsBusy('<Button busy={syncingLdap === "preview"} disabled={syncingLdap === "apply"}>'), false)
  const offenders: string[] = []
  let busyButtons = 0
  for (const file of sources.filter((entry) => entry.path.endsWith(".tsx"))) {
    for (const tag of buttonOpeningTags(file.source)) {
      if (!/\sbusy[=\s/>]/.test(tag)) continue
      busyButtons += 1
      if (!isClientModule(file.source)) offenders.push(`${file.path}: busy in a server file (its click guard cannot cross to the client)`)
      if (repeatsBusy(tag)) offenders.push(`${file.path}: disabled repeats the busy condition and drops keyboard focus`)
    }
  }
  assert.ok(busyButtons >= 1, "the guard must see at least one busy Button (DataFreshnessBanner)")
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, [])
})
```

test("the check-in photo picker explains itself before a pick and lists the queue with FileQueueList (2C batch 1b)", () => {
  const source = readFileSync("src/components/asset-operations/checkin-form.tsx", "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
  const start = source.indexOf("<FileDropzone")
  const dropzone = source.slice(start, source.indexOf("/>", start))
  assert.doesNotMatch(dropzone, /\bhint=/)
  assert.match(dropzone, /description=\{t\("photoAfterDescription"\)\}/)
  assert.match(source, /<FileQueueList\n\s+items=\{photosAfter\.map\(\(photo\) => \(\{ id: photo\.id, name: photo\.label, detail: photo\.file\.name \}\)\)\}\n\s+emptyLabel=\{t\("noQueuedPhotos"\)\}\n\s+disabled=\{saving\}/)
  assert.equal(source.match(/rounded-md bg-primary-soft text-primary/g)?.length, 1, "only the no-checkouts icon tile stays")
  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /Trash2|FileImage|t\("photoQueued"\)|t\("removePhoto"\)/)
  for (const locale of ["th", "en"]) {
    const checkin = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`messages/${locale}.json`, "utf8")).checkin as Record<string, string>
    assert.ok(checkin.photoAfterDescription?.trim(), `${locale}.checkin.photoAfterDescription`)
    assert.equal(checkin.photoQueued, undefined, `${locale}.checkin.photoQueued has no reader and is removed`)
    assert.equal(checkin.removePhoto, undefined, `${locale}.checkin.removePhoto has no reader and is removed`)
  }
})
```

(10) The local `Field` and the `Select` wrapper (§4.5): same name and props, so its 4 callers do not change. It passes `required` and `disabled` to `NativeSelect`, and the old `disabled:bg-muted …` classes go (2A gives the disabled look).

Replace:

```tsx
function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span>}
      </span>
      {children}
    </label>
  )
}

function Select({ label, value, required, disabled, onChange, children }: { label: string; value: string; required?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange: (value: string) => void; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <select value={value} required={required} disabled={disabled} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-ring focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-muted disabled:text-muted-foreground sm:h-10 sm:min-h-0">
        {children}
      </select>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

with:

```tsx
function Select({ label, value, required, disabled, onChange, children }: { label: string; value: string; required?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange: (value: string) => void; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <NativeSelect value={value} required={required} disabled={disabled} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}>
        {children}
      </NativeSelect>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

Replace:

```tsx
function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">

        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span>}
      </span>

  )
}

function Select({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <select value={value} required={required} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-ring focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring sm:h-10 sm:min-h-0">
        {children}
      </select>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

with:

```tsx
function Select({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <NativeSelect value={value} required={required} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}>
        {children}
      </NativeSelect>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

// Task 10 CSS check: run from the repo root. Compiles src/app/globals.css in memory and confirms that every class name
// batch 1a and 1b write by hand produces CSS (Tailwind 4 emits nothing for a misspelled class or a missing token). Never commit this file.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { createRequire } from "node:module"
import { resolve } from "node:path"

const require = createRequire(resolve("package.json"))
const { compile } = require("@tailwindcss/node")
const compiler = await compile(readFileSync("src/app/globals.css", "utf8"), { base: resolve("src/app"), onDependency() {} })
const classes = [
  // batch 1a

].join(" ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
const css = compiler.build(classes)
const escape = (name) => name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, (char) => `\\${char}`)
const missing = classes.filter((name) => !css.includes(`.${escape(name)}`))
if (missing.length > 0) {

}

- [ ] **Step 2: Save the budget script**

This is the same script as Task 9 Step 2. If `<temp>/p2c-budget.mjs` is not there, save this as `p2c-budget.mjs` in your temp folder (never in the repo):

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

Notes:
- The Field `hint` is not used for the historical reason: spec 4.3 F6 keeps `aria-describedby={evidenceExceptionReasonHelpId}` on the `Textarea` (the test pins it), and `Field` puts that id first in the `aria-describedby` it passes on.
- Every control in the dialog keeps `disabled={saving}`, so the whole form greys out while it saves (spec 4.13).
- The confirm button moves `saving` out of `submitDisabled` into `busy`. Focus stays on it, and Cancel and X are disabled through the dialog.

import assert from "node:assert/strict"

  )

  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /function AssetStateFieldLabel|function Field\(/)

  assert.match(source, /error=\{duplicateState\.serialNumberExists \? t\("duplicateSerialNumber"\) : undefined\}>\n\s*<ScannerTextInput/)

If `<temp>/p2c-budget.mjs` is not in your temp folder, save this as `p2c-budget.mjs` there (never in the repo):

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span>}
      </span>
      {children}
    </label>
  )
}

function AssetStateFieldLabel({
  label,
  required,
  help,
}: {
  label: string
  required?: boolean
  help: { title: string; description: string; items: string[] }
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
      <span>
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span>}
      </span>
      <AssetStateHelpPopover {...help} />
    </div>
  )
}

function SelectField({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <select
        value={value}
        required={required}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-ring focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring sm:h-10 sm:min-h-0"
      >
        {children}
      </select>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

// Keeps the name and props it had before 2C, so its 12 call sites stay as they are. hint carries the help line

function SelectField({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  hint,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  hint?: React.ReactNode
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required} hint={hint}>
      <NativeSelect value={value} required={required} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}>
        {children}
      </NativeSelect>
    </Field>
  )
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Lower this file's budgets**

Use the budget script of Task 9 Step 2. If `<temp>/p2c-budget.mjs` is not in your temp folder, save this as `p2c-budget.mjs` there (never in the repo):

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

```tsx
function BatchOptionalColumnToggle({
  label,
  active,
  count,
  onClick,
}: {
  label: string
  active: boolean
  count: number
  onClick: () => void
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 ${
        active
          ? "border-primary bg-primary-soft text-primary hover:bg-primary-soft"
          : "border-border bg-background text-foreground hover:bg-accent"
      }`}
      aria-pressed={active}
    >
      <span>{label}</span>
      {count > 0 ? (
        <span className="rounded-full bg-background px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {count}
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </button>
  )
}

function Field({ label, required, children }: { label: string; required?: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <span className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-danger">*</span>}
      </span>
      {children}
    </label>
  )
}

function SelectField({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required}>
      <select value={value} required={required} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} className={inputClassName}>
        {children}
      </select>
    </Field>
  )
}

const inputClassName = "min-h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-ring focus:ring-1 focus:ring-ring sm:h-10 sm:min-h-0"
```

// A real checkbox chip (K16): Space toggles it and Enter does not submit the batch form. Still checked while rows
// hold their own value, as before (spec 2C section 7.4.4).
function BatchOptionalColumnToggle({
  label,
  active,
  count,
  onClick,
}: {
  label: string
  active: boolean
  count: number
  onClick: () => void
}) {
  return <ChoiceChip type="checkbox" checked={active} onChange={onClick} label={label} detail={count > 0 ? <span className="num">{count}</span> : undefined} />
}

// Keeps the name and props it had before 2C, so its 12 call sites stay as they are. hint carries the help line
// that used to sit in a <p> under 2 of them (spec 2C section 4.3 F6).
function SelectField({
  label,
  value,
  required,
  hint,
  onChange,
  children,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  required?: boolean
  hint?: React.ReactNode
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={label} required={required} hint={hint}>
      <NativeSelect value={value} required={required} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}>
        {children}
      </NativeSelect>
    </Field>
  )
}

If `<temp>/p2c-budget.mjs` is not in your temp folder, save this as `p2c-budget.mjs` there (never in the repo); Steps 4 and 13 use it. It is the budget script of Task 9 Step 2:

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

function edit(path, oldText, newText) {
  const text = readFileSync(path, "utf8")
  const count = text.split(oldText).length - 1
  if (count !== 1) {
    console.error(`ABORT ${path}: expected the old text once, found it ${count} times. Nothing written.`)
    process.exit(1)
  }
  writeFileSync(path, text.replace(oldText, () => newText))
  console.log(`edited ${path}`)
}

// Every route under the dashboard, read from its page.tsx files, with [segments] kept as written (spec 2C section 9.3).
function dashboardRoutes(dir = "src/app/[locale]/(dashboard)", prefix = ""): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = join(dir, entry)
    if (statSync(path).isDirectory()) return dashboardRoutes(path, prefix ? `${prefix}/${entry}` : entry)
    return entry === "page.tsx" ? [prefix] : []
  })
}
// The four asset task pages are focus routes without being forms (phase 1).
const TASK_ROUTES = new Set(["asset-management/checkout", "asset-management/checkin", "asset-management/transfer", "asset-management/bulk-move"])

test("GL2 form routes hide the bottom navigation and list routes keep it (K15)", () => {
  const routes = dashboardRoutes()
  assert.ok(routes.length > 70, `expected the dashboard routes, found ${routes.length}`)
  const wrong: string[] = []
  for (const route of routes) {
    const mode = getMobileShellMode(`/th/${route.replace(/\[[^\]]+\]/g, "sample-1")}`)
    const isForm = /(?:^|\/)new$|\/\[[^\]]+\]\/edit$/.test(route) || route === "admin/settings"
    const isList = !route.includes("[") && !isForm && !TASK_ROUTES.has(route)
    if (isForm && mode !== "focus") wrong.push(`${route}: ${mode}, a form route must be focus`)
    if (isList && mode !== "navigation") wrong.push(`${route}: ${mode}, a list route keeps the bottom navigation`)
  }
  assert.deepEqual(wrong, [])
})
```

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

```js
// Task 19: confirm Tailwind 4.2.4 builds CSS for every class the settings migration adds. Tailwind skips an unknown
// class without an error. Run from the repo root: node <your temp folder>/t19-css-check.mjs   (never commit this file)
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"

const { compile } = await import(pathToFileURL(`${process.cwd()}/node_modules/@tailwindcss/node/dist/index.mjs`).href)
const css = readFileSync("src/app/globals.css", "utf8")
const files = {
  "src/components/admin/system-settings-form.tsx": [
    "h-auto", "justify-start", "whitespace-normal", "py-2", "text-left", "md:h-auto", "md:min-h-10", "font-mono", "uppercase",
    "sr-only", "sm:not-sr-only", "space-y-6", "mt-1", "hidden", "sm:block", "text-meta", "text-muted-foreground", "w-full",
    "sm:w-fit", "sm:w-auto", "mt-4",
  ]
}
const fresh = () => compile(css, { base: `${process.cwd()}/src/app`, onDependency: () => {} })
const empty = (await fresh()).build([]).length
const problems = []
let total = 0
for (const [path, classes] of Object.entries(files)) {
  const source = readFileSync(path, "utf8")
  for (const name of classes) {
    total += 1
    if (!source.includes(name)) problems.push(`${path}: ${name} is not in the file`)
    if ((await fresh()).build([name]).length === empty) problems.push(`${name}: Tailwind built no CSS`)
  }
}
console.log(`built ${total - problems.length}/${total} classes`)
if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(problems.join("\n"))
  process.exit(1)
}
```

Rulings this task applies:
- **I20, §7.4.4 T6:** the group buttons become `<ChoiceChip type="radio">` with one `name` from `useId()`, inside `<div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={groupsHeadingId}>` that exists only when there are groups (the "no groups" line stays outside it). The chip is disabled while the policy JSON is invalid and keeps its chosen fill (I20's disabled rule), so a user can still see which group is open. `ChoiceChip` swallows Enter, so Enter on a chip never saves the whole settings form (§7.4.2).
- **§4.9:** the picker search is `SearchField fieldSize="md"` with `aria-label={searchLabel}`; the two preview fields are `Field` + `Input fieldSize="md"`, and `PreviewInputField` and `previewInputClassName` go. The price field keeps `type="text"` → `inputMode="decimal"` → `value={formatPurchasePriceInput(previewPurchasePrice)}` in that order (`settings-depreciation-policy-ui.test.ts:50`).
- **§4.8 row 2:** the JSON box is `<Field label={labels.depreciationAdvancedJson} hideLabel hint={labels.depreciationAdvancedJsonDescription}>` + `Textarea`; the description paragraph above the box goes (it becomes the hint under it).
- **§4.3 F3, §6.2.1:** `inputClassName`, `previewInputClassName` and `compactButtonClassName` go with their last users.
- **§6.3:** #6 add group `outline`, #7 and #8 `outline`, #9 remove group `danger`; all keep their `disabled` expressions (`settings-depreciation-policy-ui.test.ts:55-56`).

Rulings made in this plan:
- **The radio group changes the keyboard path.** Today each group is its own Tab stop. As one radio group, Tab enters the group once and the arrow keys move between groups and open them, as radios do. That follows from I20's `type="radio"` and is the expected pattern for a single choice.

```js
// p2c-budget.mjs: run from the repo root. Edits tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts for ONE migrated file: lowers or
// removes its entries in the named budgets, appends it to MIGRATED_FILES and, with --footer-done, drops it from
// PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS. It checks every current value first and writes nothing on any mismatch. Never commit this file.
// Usage: node p2c-budget.mjs <path under src/components/> NAME=from:to ... [--footer-done]   (to = 0 deletes the entry)
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const GUARD = "tests/form-migration-guards.test.ts"
const BUDGETS = ["LOCAL_FIELD", "RAW_FIELDS", "FIELD_CLASS_STRINGS", "OLD_MARKUP", "LOADER2", "REVERSE", "OLD_HELPERS", "FIXED_BOTTOM_BARS", "CLOSE_LABEL_IS_CANCEL"]
const [file, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
const footerDone = args.includes("--footer-done")
const edits = args.filter((arg) => arg !== "--footer-done").map((arg) => {
  const match = /^([A-Z0-9_]+)=(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(arg)
  if (!match || !BUDGETS.includes(match[1])) throw new Error(`bad edit: ${arg}`)
  return { name: match[1], from: Number(match[2]), to: Number(match[3]) }
})
const raw = readFileSync(GUARD, "utf8")
const eol = raw.includes("\r\n") ? "\r\n" : "\n"
const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/)
const quoted = file.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\/]/g, "\\$&")
// An entry key as Task 7 writes it: [`${C}path`] or "src/components/path".
const key = String.raw`(?:\[` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`\]|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const item = String.raw`(?:` + "`" + String.raw`\$\{C\}` + quoted + "`" + String.raw`|"src/components/` + quoted + `")`
const problems = []

// The lines from `const NAME` to the line that closes it at column 0, or the same line for a one-line value.
function block(name) {
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => line !== null && new RegExp(String.raw`^const ${name}\b`).test(line))
  if (start === -1) return null
  if (/[}\]]\)?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$/.test(lines[start]) && !/[{[(]\s*$/.test(lines[start])) return { start, end: start }
  const end = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > start && line !== null && /^[}\]]/.test(line))
  return { start, end }
}

for (const name of BUDGETS) {
  const range = block(name)
  if (!range) { problems.push(`const ${name} not found`); continue }
  let index = -1
  let value = 0
  for (let at = range.start; at <= range.end; at += 1) {
    const match = new RegExp(key + String.raw`\s*:\s*(\d+)`).exec(lines[at])
    if (match) { index = at; value = Number(match[1]); break }
  }
  const edit = edits.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name)
  if (!edit) { if (value > 0) problems.push(`${name} still holds ${value} for ${file}; name it in this command`); continue }
  if (value !== edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: expected ${edit.from} for ${file}, found ${value}`); continue }
  if (edit.to === edit.from) continue
  if (edit.to > edit.from) { problems.push(`${name}: a budget never goes up`); continue }
  const line = lines[index]
  if (edit.to > 0) lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp("(" + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*)\d+`), `$1${edit.to}`)
  else if (range.start !== range.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(line)) lines[index] = null
  else lines[index] = line.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\s*` + key + String.raw`\s*:\s*\d+,?`), "").replace(/\{\s*,?\s*\}/, "{}")
  console.log(`${name}: ${edit.from} -> ${edit.to}`)
}

const migrated = block("MIGRATED_FILES")
const entry = "  `${C}" + file + "`,"
if (!migrated) problems.push("const MIGRATED_FILES not found")
else if (lines.slice(migrated.start, migrated.end + 1).some((line) => line !== null && line.includes("${C}" + file + "`"))) problems.push(`${file} is already in MIGRATED_FILES`)
else if (/= \[\]\s*$/.test(lines[migrated.start])) lines.splice(migrated.start, 1, lines[migrated.start].replace(/\[\]\s*$/, "["), entry, "]")
else if (migrated.start === migrated.end) problems.push("MIGRATED_FILES is a one-line list that is not empty: add the entry by hand")
else lines.splice(migrated.end, 0, entry)

if (footerDone) {
  const pending = block("PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS")
  const at = pending ? lines.findIndex((line, index) => index >= pending.start && index <= pending.end && line !== null && new RegExp(item).test(line)) : -1
  if (at === -1) problems.push(`${file} is not in PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS`)
  else if (pending.start !== pending.end && new RegExp(String.raw`^\s*` + item + String.raw`,?\s*(?:\/\/.*)?$`).test(lines[at])) {
    lines[at] = null
    console.log(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS: removed ${file}`)
  } else problems.push(`PENDING_FOOTER_PARTS entry for ${file} shares a line: remove it by hand`)
}

if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing written:\n${problems.join("\n")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
writeFileSync(GUARD, lines.filter((line) => line !== null).join(eol))
console.log(`MIGRATED_FILES: added ${file}`)
```

```js
// Task 20: confirm Tailwind 4.2.4 builds CSS for every class the builder migration adds. Tailwind skips an unknown
// class without an error. Run from the repo root: node <your temp folder>/t20-css-check.mjs   (never commit this file)
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url"

const { compile } = await import(pathToFileURL(`${process.cwd()}/node_modules/@tailwindcss/node/dist/index.mjs`).href)
const css = readFileSync("src/app/globals.css", "utf8")
const files = {
  "src/components/admin/depreciation-policy-builder.tsx": ["has-disabled:cursor-not-allowed", "has-disabled:text-faint-foreground", "num", "mt-3", "mt-0.5"],
}
const fresh = () => compile(css, { base: `${process.cwd()}/src/app`, onDependency: () => {} })
const empty = (await fresh()).build([]).length
const problems = []
let total = 0
for (const [path, classes] of Object.entries(files)) {
  const source = readFileSync(path, "utf8")
  for (const name of classes) {
    total += 1
    if (!source.includes(name)) problems.push(`${path}: ${name} is not in the file`)
    if ((await fresh()).build([name]).length === empty) problems.push(`${name}: Tailwind built no CSS`)
  }
}
console.log(`built ${total - problems.length}/${total} classes`)
if (problems.length > 0) {
  console.error(problems.join("\n"))
  process.exit(1)
}
```

    return [...text.slice(from, text.indexOf(closer, from)).matchAll(/\]?"?: (\d+),/g)].reduce((sum, match) => sum + Number(match[1]), 0)

with:

```md
- **Hand-written buttons** keep their own classes until 2B, the later 2C batches and 2D move them; phase 2C batch 1 moved the form and dialog buttons of its 26 files (all but the repair attachment delete dialog, which batch 5 turns into `useConfirm`). Pick the size from today's desktop height: `h-8` → `sm`, `h-9` → `md`, `h-10` beside 40px fields → `lg`, any other `h-10` → no size (`default`). A button that is 44px tall on desktop (`min-h-11` only, dialog footers included) also takes no size: it becomes 40px now and 36px after 2D (phase 2C ruling K7).
- **Order (K8):** the primary action comes last in the DOM, so the visual order and the Tab order agree. In a form's button row, a dialog footer and `StickyFormFooter`, the secondary action (Cancel) comes first. Phones stack the buttons full width with Cancel on top and the primary action at the bottom (`flex-col`, never `flex-col-reverse`); from `sm` they form a right-aligned row. Guard GD4 holds the remaining `flex-col-reverse` lines in a per-file budget.
- **Delete icons:** an icon button that removes a row and is neutral at rest uses `outline`, with no red on hover (phase 2C ruling K22); one that is red at rest stays `danger`. Taking a file out of an upload queue is the `outline` `icon-sm` button of `FileQueueList`.
- **`Segmented`** (`src/components/ui/segmented.tsx`, server-safe): a row of toggle buttons where exactly one is on (`aria-pressed`), named by its required `aria-label`. A white frame with a `border` line, 8px corners and 2px padding and gap; options use `rounded-control` and `text-sm`. The chosen option is `primary-soft` with `primary-hover` text at weight 600; the others are weight 500 `muted-foreground` with a `background` hover. `size` `sm` is 32px from `md` (the default) and `md` 36px; below `md` both are 44px. `fill` stretches the frame and shares it equally, and `showCheck` puts a check before the chosen label so the choice does not rely on color. Values are strings, and every option is its own Tab stop. The focus ring has no offset, because the options are only 2px apart.

Replace:

```md
- **Busy dialogs:** Pass `busy` while saving; the dialog then ignores Escape, outside clicks and the close button.
- **Confirmation:** Never use `window.confirm`. Call `await confirm({ title, confirmLabel, tone })` from `useConfirm()`; destructive actions use `tone: "destructive"` and report the actual result ("ลบแล้ว", not "บันทึกสำเร็จ").
```

with:

```md
- **`AccessibleDialog` parts** (`src/components/ui/accessible-dialog.tsx`): the header holds the 16px semibold title and an optional `description` (a `ReactNode`: a record code in it is wrapped in `tag`, and a name after the code follows " · "). Below it the content slot scrolls. A dialog with fields or buttons uses `AccessibleDialogBody` (white, `px-4 py-4 sm:px-5`, scrolls on its own, no gap of its own) and `AccessibleDialogFooter` (outside the scroll area, so it is always visible; `background` fill, a `border-soft` top line, `px-4 py-3 sm:px-5`, buttons only). A `<form onSubmit>` wraps both and takes `className={accessibleDialogFormClasses}`; without it the whole form scrolls and the footer can scroll away (guard GD6). A dialog that has not moved to the parts yet scrolls as before.
- **Footer buttons (K8):** `AccessibleDialogCancel` first (an `outline` button, "ยกเลิก" by default, that closes the dialog), any other secondary action next, the primary action last, so the visual order is the DOM and Tab order. Phones stack them full width with Cancel on top; from `sm` they form a right-aligned row that may wrap. The footer holds only `Button` and `AccessibleDialogCancel`, with no `className`, no `size=`, no hand-written `<button>`, no `Loader2` and no `flex-col-reverse` (guard GD3). The primary action is `default`; `destructive` only confirms a destructive action; `warning` is for the 2 audit "not found" confirms. Footer labels stay under 40 characters; a sentence goes into the body as a `Notice`.
- **Busy dialogs:** Pass `busy` while saving; the dialog then ignores Escape, outside clicks and the close button, `AccessibleDialogCancel` is disabled, and the button that started the work stays where it is with `busy`, so focus stays on it.
- **Close X:** a `ghost` `icon` `Button` in the top-right corner of every dialog and sheet, named "ปิด" (`common.close`). Pass `closeLabel` only when the name really differs. While the dialog is busy, the X is disabled and has no box.
- **Phones:** the dialog box sits at least 12px above the bottom edge and clear of the iPhone home bar (`bottom-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` on the box); the footer adds no padding for it. Bottom sheets pad the home bar (`pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`).
- **A dialog rendered inside another `<form>`** (the asset-number prefix dialog of the settings page) has no `<form>` of its own and no `type="submit"`. React sends `submit` up the component tree, through the portal, so a nested form would save the whole settings page (guard GD5). If Enter should ever act there, use an `onKeyDown` handler.
- **Sheets:** white (`bg-surface`, like dialog bodies). `SheetHeader` has a bottom line and is 56px tall (`py-4 pr-16`, room for the X), and `SheetTitle` is 16px semibold.
- **Confirmation:** Never use `window.confirm`. Call `await confirm({ title, confirmLabel, tone })` from `useConfirm()`; destructive actions use `tone: "destructive"` and report the actual result ("ลบแล้ว", not "บันทึกสำเร็จ"). `confirmLabel` names the action with a verb ("ลบ", "ละทิ้ง"), not "ยืนยัน"; 4 calls still lack one until phase 2C batch 5, which also gives the confirm dialog the `AccessibleDialog` look. On phones it already stacks Cancel above the action.
```

Save this script in your temp folder as `update-design-json-2c.mjs` and never commit it.
- It checks every target first and writes nothing on a mismatch.
- It keeps CRLF. `JSON.stringify(…, null, 2)` reproduces the file byte for byte at `5ffee76`, so only the new parts change.
- Every class value in the CSS is the code's, expanded to plain CSS. Fills and lines are the token hex values from `DESIGN.md` §2.

```js
// Task 22: bring .impeccable/design.json in line with DESIGN.md after phase 2C plan 1.
// Run from the repo root: node <your temp folder>/update-design-json-2c.mjs [path]   (never commit this file)
// Checks every target first and writes nothing if one is missing. Keeps the file's CRLF line endings.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

const path = process.argv[2] ?? ".impeccable/design.json"
const raw = readFileSync(path, "utf8")
const crlf = raw.includes("\r\n")
const d = JSON.parse(raw)
const problems = []
const check = (ok, message) => {
  if (!ok) problems.push(message)
}

const font = `"IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif`
const refs = d.components.map((component) => component.refersTo)
check(JSON.stringify(refs) === JSON.stringify(["button-primary", "button-secondary", "input", "panel", "badge-status", "navigation"]), `components are not the 6 of phase 2A: ${refs.join(", ")}`)
check(d.narrative.dos[0].startsWith("Do preserve existing tokens and shared primitives such as Button, the field primitives"), "dos[0] is not the phase 2A text")
check(d.narrative.donts.length === 9, `donts has ${d.narrative.donts.length} lines, not 9`)
check(d.generatedAt === "2026-10-11T00:00:00+07:00", `generatedAt is ${d.generatedAt}`)

if (problems.length) {
  console.error(`ABORT, nothing was written:\n- ${problems.join("\n- ")}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
